title: Chemical Drain Cleaners: Quick Fix or Pipe Hazard?
description: Chemical drain cleaners are often viewed as a simple solution for clogged pipes, but they frequently cause severe long-term damage. Most caustic drain openers rely on exothermic chemical reactions to break down organic matter. In PVC or older metallic drainage systems, this extreme heat and acidity can warp pipes, erode seals, and soften joints. Furthermore, standing chemical solutions create major safety hazards for technicians who must later snake or disassemble the trap assembly. Mechanical removal using a hand auger or drain snake remains the safe, professional method for clearing obstructions without compromising drainage infrastructure.
